summary: Username and password inputs inside the same-origin iframe appFrame of the iLO page, submitted with the Enter key. This is the login the user's cdp-auth tool lists as known working for HP iLO.

sources.title: cdp-auth readme, Known working logins: the iLO configuration string with the two input ids and the iframe id
sources.note: Lines 97-99 define the positions of the string: username input id, password input id, iframe id. The line is already present at commit 5a77efeb (2023-09-19). The iLO generation and firmware are not stated.

sources.title: cdp-auth field_id+iframe mode: set both inputs by id inside the iframe found by id, then press Enter
sources.note: The ids are read from the configuration string, not written in the script. The Enter key is sent by pressEnterKey, lines 415-446.

sources.title: cdp-auth setValueOfIdInIframe: the iframe is reached through contentWindow.document, so it is same-origin
The existing iLO profile (the entry with id ilo), which already pins the same-origin login frame appFrame
Native frame-scoped login tests for appFrame; their form is generic and does not use the iLO field ids
Forum thread on filling the iLO 5 login: other ids than the ones cdp-auth records
sources.note: Thread of 2020-06-13, iLO 5 firmware 2.14: form id login-form, username id username, password id password, login button id login-form__submit. It does not say whether the form is inside a frame. Not used by any selector here.

sources.title: Public panel-detection template for iLO 5: the login document is /html/login.html
sources.note: Not used by any selector or fixture here.

selectors.locator: line 29, third field of the string; lines 97-98 say it is the username input id
line 29, fourth field of the string; lines 97-98 say it is the password input id

fixtures.note: The top document holds only the iframe with id appFrame (line 29, fifth field). The path is the connection's own URL; the source names none.

The source gives the two ids only. The frame document's path, the type attributes and whether a form element wraps the inputs are not in the source; no selector relies on them and the steps carry no path gate.

staysInteractive.note: Any second factor or directory sign-in the administrator enabled. The existing profile text says MFA remains manual; cdp-auth records nothing after the Enter key.

schemaGaps: The existing generic iLO profile looks for the form in the top document or in appFrame. The steps format types each credential in one step per origin, so a top-document alternative cannot be written beside the frame step. The steps cover the appFrame layout only, which is the one cdp-auth records.

iLO 5 firmware 2.14 has other ids according to a forum thread (source ilo5-thread). They are not in the steps: where that form sits (top document or frame) is not known, and a selector from a forum post would make the whole login unverified.
notes: Firmware: cdp-auth does not say which iLO generation or firmware the string was used on. The steps match only a login inside an iframe with id appFrame whose inputs have these two ids; on any other generation it is a layout mismatch and nothing is typed. cdp-auth sets the values by script; here they are typed. No submit control is known, so submission is the Enter key in the password field, as in cdp-auth.
